context_requirements: Bacterial peptidoglycan synthesis machinery (MurA and downstream enzymes), which human cells lack
Bacterial cell envelope or actively growing bacteria; not present in axenic human cell lines
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine human cell lines
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple cell lines that is not explained by vehicle, cytotoxicity, or nonspecific stress
Evidence of a human MurA ortholog or peptidoglycan synthesis pathway whose inhibition alters transcription in these lines

evidence.supports: Fosfomycin is a bacterial cell wall synthesis inhibitor targeting MurA, the first enzyme in the bacterial peptidoglycan pathway; the relevant biology is bacterial, not human.
